name: GLOBAL_MARKET_RECEIPT_V0_1
purpose: One PIT-safe envelope for D12/D13 global and derivative research observations; instrument-specific payloads remain separate.
decisionClockRule: For System1/System2 after-market research, pointInTimeEligible requires knownAtTaipei <= 18:10 Asia/Taipei for that selection date.
commonGuards: Observed value and later close/settlement are different objects.
Current snapshot cannot be backfilled as historical first-known receipt.
Holidays and no-new-session states are explicit, not zero returns.
Revised macro values do not overwrite initial-release receipts.
Contract rolls and product/rules changes require version metadata.
Regional commodity prices are preserved separately when markets diverge.
implementationClass: Class A only if isolated research storage/fetch path does not change shared Formal runtime, scheduling, budgets or schema; otherwise Class B proposal-first.
